result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor clipping issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped/truncated on the right side. Both the image and the restaurant name are cut off, indicating a horizontal overflow or improper carousel/scroll container configuration.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container allows partial visibility of the next card intentionally as a scroll affordance, and that the restaurant name text is properly truncated with an ellipsis rather than abruptly cut off. If it's meant to hint at scrollability, add a visible scroll indicator or ensure consistent peek width.

issues.description: The last visible restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza restaurant with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the screen without any clear visual affordance indicating it is scrollable, making it unclear to users that more content exists below.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll indicator or ensure the card cutoff is visually consistent and intentional to communicate vertical scrollability to the user.
